format: get_infov2 hours. kind=map_info_v2: input is the raw array -> {halls, retail} (mapInfoV2). kind=street_address / map_address: input string or null -> string or null. kind=status: input {hours: DiningHallHours, now} -> {mealPeriod, openStatus, effective}; now is an absolute instant (ISO 8601 with offset), and the wall clock it is read in is America/New_York (get_infov2 times are Eastern wall-clock; DST days are included). openStatus is {open:true, closesAt} or {open:false, opensAt} with opensAt null when nothing opens later today; closesAt/opensAt are UTC instants (ISO 8601 'Z'). effective maps each of breakfast/lunch/dinner/latenight to the window effectiveMealWindow returns, or null. Windows are {openTime, closeTime} strings exactly as published, except effective windows synthesized from `general`, which are re-formatted as 'H:MM AM/PM'. Every case is {kind, name, input, expected}; expected is what shared/src (TypeScript) returns for input. JSON null = a value that is present and null. An ABSENT key = undefined / not set: implementations must treat a missing key and an unset field as the same thing, and must not emit null for it. Regenerate with `pnpm --filter @udine/shared vectors`; never hand-edit expected.
